messages:
jenna: Quick follow-up on PR #1302 — ran the linter and there's a couple tiny naming/format nits. Can folks check timing for a quick review/merge?

omar: On it. I glanced earlier — mostly a ctx var rename and one comment wording.

lisa: I can review after stand. Any behavioral changes or just renames/format?

jenna: Just renames + formatting. No logic changes. Specifically: rename local `ctx` -> `requestCtx`, update a comment on kv cache sizing, and run gofmt/golangci-lint.

tyler: Left an inline about the magic number in kv_cache.go — prefer `kMaxKVSize` constant. Also prefer `requestCtx` to be more explicit.

jenna: Thanks — pushed a tiny commit addressing tyler's const suggestion and the rename. Diff:
```diff
- ctx := req.Context()
+ requestCtx := req.Context()
```

jenna: And ran formatter: `gofmt -w .` plus `./scripts/check-style.sh` locally.

omar: run CI? I'll re-run the linter job in a bit. If green, this looks mergeable.

ci-bot: build-and-lint #1302 — re-run requested by omar.

ci-bot: build-and-lint #1302 — ✅ all checks passed (gofmt, golangci-lint, unit tests).

lisa: Quick review done — left one optional nit about a comment phrasing, otherwise LGTM. :thumbsup:

tyler: Approved — LGTM.

omar: Approving now so it can land in today's merge window.

jenna: Thanks all — can someone merge when you have a free slot? Prefer before tomorrow's deploy window to avoid rolling through canary.

omar: I'll merge in ~15m if nothing else pops up.

ci-bot: merge-bot: PR #1302 queued for merge on green.

jenna: Merged main at commit 8a7f3d2 — thanks y'all.

tyler: Nice, thanks!

lisa: Nice and tidy.

jenna: Follow-up: I'll open a tiny doc note about naming conventions for request contexts so this recurs less.

omar: Good idea. Could add that to devex style guide.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: rolling canary scheduled for next deployment window.

jenna: closing this thread. Appreciated the quick turn. :rocket:
